messages:
maria: Customer on prod reported invoice mismatch vs dashboard. Dashboard shows $123.45 for April, invoice INV-2026-0456 shows $123.44. They dug into line items — lots of sub-cent differences across many requests. Can we verify?

sam: please paste invoice id + account id (or link).

maria: INV-2026-0456, acct: ac_9876. Customer provided sample lines: `2026-04-01T12:34:22Z | req_9f8a | tokens: 0.0012 | unit_price_usd: 0.25` -> dashboard shows $0.0003, invoice line computed $0.0002. Looks like per-line truncation to 4 decimal places of cents.

kevin: I think this is the microcent truncation bug we saw in aggregator v2. We switched to truncating instead of rounding in commit c3f2d last quarter to keep deterministic sums, but that yields cumulative shortfall when you sum many tiny lines. I can repro. Steps: `checkout billing-aggregator && ./local_agg --invoice INV-2026-0456 --recompute` returns total 123.4400 vs dashboard 123.4500.

kevin: repro snippet:
```
-- simplified SQL from aggregator
SELECT SUM(FLOOR((tokens * price_per_token) * 10000) / 10000) AS invoice_total
FROM usage_lines
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2026-0456';
```
This floors to 4 decimal cents. Dashboard uses `ROUND(amount, 4)` and then final totals are rounded half-up to cents.

anya: That explains it. Two asks: (1) quick remediation for customer (credit or reissue invoice), (2) fix aggregator behavior and backfill historical invoices within threshold. @garrett can you take the PR?

garrett: Taking. Plan: change FLOOR -> ROUND_HALF_UP in aggregator, add unit tests, and a backfill that recomputes invoices where abs(diff) > 0.005 or > $0.01 (configurable). Estimate 3-4h dev + 1h QA. Will open PR and flag for ops deploy.

maria: Customer wants an ETA and explanation. I'll offer a temporary credit for the delta and note we'll re-run invoices if larger than $1.

billing-bot: Automated: preliminary credit $0.01 applied to INV-2026-0456 (pending manual review).

sam: Also note: need audit for non-USD currency conversion path. Rounding in intermediate FX rates can amplify differences -> add integration test for EUR/JPY invoices.

kevin: Agreed. Relevant code paths: `currency_convert()` in billing-core and the aggregator rounding stage. We'll unify on banker's/half-up rounding for money operations and log metrics `billing.rounding.mode`.

anya: Thanks. maria — please send customer short note: explanation + credit + ETA 8 hours. I'll follow up on backfill schedule.

maria: Will do. Sending update now. :pray:
